note: Expected findings are the code, path, message and suggestion `orb validate` (the Rust validator) reports for ORB_PAGE_UNREACHABLE on the same program. Each case copies a page.rs reachability test named in its id (validate_page_reachability, collect_href_strings, collect_reachability_signals); the cases without a test name pin a branch of those functions the tests leave open (tick effects, the static navigate prefix, the @pages sigil in app config and in an effect, schema-wide reachability, per-orbital indexes). The lazyPages half of validate_page_reachability is not ported: a lazy page's links are not serialized into the program, so the page.rs lazy-page tests have no golden.
